status: reference-grounded qualitative contract; not dimensional metrology or acceptance

referenceRoles.ownerWholebird: Controls neutral closed-mouth exterior, overall face identity, optic integration and wrapped armor direction.
referenceRoles.julyHeadOnly: Controls head construction cues and an open-jaw pose only; does not control body proportions or neutral mouth closure.

qualitativeLandmarks: Owner neutral mouth is nearly closed with a narrow irregular dark seam; July head-only pose has a pronounced open gape and curved raised mandible.
Upper bill has a deep hooked profile, tapering and curling down at the tip; lower mandible is a separate curved jaw, not a straight shelf.
Optic is recessed within concentric structure, overlapped by brow above and framed by cheek below/front; dark aperture remains legible around the lens.
Brow-to-bill and cheek-to-hinge transitions sweep diagonally; eye, facial plates and jaw read as one assembly.
Crown and temporal plates overlap aft around the skull, retaining a continuous outside contour with small shadow gaps rather than a floating cap or large roof void.
limits: References have different perspective/camera framing; no exact ratios or real-world dimensions are inferred.
July reference is head-only and must not contribute body proportions.
